research.market.sub.en: Public charts from ReelShort and DramaBox through one story-type taxonomy: what is prominent, what the charts are made of, and where your catalog fits.
research.market.sub.zh: ReelShort、DramaBox 的公开榜单，经同一套题材体系整理：什么最显眼、榜单由什么构成、你的剧库处在哪里。

research.market.noData.en: No published market snapshot. Run the crawl to create one.
research.market.noData.zh: 暂无市场快照，请先运行采集。

research.market.invalid.en: The published snapshot failed validation and is not shown. See Data & Sources.
research.market.invalid.zh: 已发布的快照未通过校验，未显示。见数据与来源。

research.market.firstObservation.en: First observation day; change columns turn on with the second.
research.market.firstObservation.zh: 首个采集日，第二个采集日后显示变化。

research.scope.value.en: English public catalogs · audience geography unknown
research.scope.value.zh: 英文公开目录 · 观众地域未知

research.state.collectingHint.en: Needs a second observation day to show change.
research.state.collectingHint.zh: 需要再采集一天才能显示变化。

research.state.noProfile.zh: 填写工作室资料后显示

research.state.noCatalog.en: Shown once you add a title

research.section.prominentSub.en: Within-platform prominence: view percentile or chart position, whichever is higher. Not momentum.
research.section.prominentSub.zh: 平台内显著度：观看分位或榜单位置，取高者。不是势头。

research.section.insightsSub.en: Templated from the snapshot; each cites the listings it was computed from.
research.section.insightsSub.zh: 由快照按模板生成；每条都引用其计算依据的作品。

research.section.storyMixSub.en: Share of the prominence cohort carrying each trope. Multi-label: shares sum above 100%.
research.section.storyMixSub.zh: 显著剧集中含各题材的占比。多标签：合计会超过 100%。

research.section.yourTitlesSub.en: Tagged from your synopses; similarity to prominent listings, not success probability.
research.section.yourTitlesSub.zh: 根据你的简介打标签；是与显著剧集的相似度，不代表成功概率。

research.section.newListingsSub.en: Marked new by the platform in this crawl. "First seen by us" starts with the second observation day.
research.section.newListingsSub.zh: 本次采集中平台标记为新上架。「我们首次发现」从第二个采集日开始。

research.section.tropes.en: What the charts are made of

research.section.companiesSub.en: As the platform shows them, with the role kept. DramaBox names a publisher; ReelShort names none beyond its own originals.
research.section.companiesSub.zh: 以平台公开信息为准，保留角色。DramaBox 显示出版方；ReelShort 仅标出自制剧。

research.formats.note.en: Medians per platform with sample sizes: episodes per listing, first paid episode, episode length (basis named, never pooled).
research.formats.note.zh: 按平台的中位数及样本量：每部集数、首个付费集、单集时长（注明口径，不合并）。

research.coverage.zh: 覆盖：{listings} 个上架条目 · {platforms} 个平台

research.coverage.note.zh: 是平台上架条目，不是去重后的剧集数。

research.insight.tropeLift.en: "{trope}" is {lift}× as common among prominent listings as in the tracked sample ({inCohort} of {cohort} vs {titles} of {sample}).
research.insight.tropeLift.zh: 「{trope}」在显著作品中的占比是整体样本的 {lift} 倍（前 {cohort} 部中 {inCohort} 部；样本 {sample} 部中 {titles} 部）。

research.insight.paywallGap.en: {a} puts the first paid episode at {aMedian} (n={aN}); {b} at {bMedian} (n={bN}).
research.insight.paywallGap.zh: {a} 的首个付费集中位为第 {aMedian} 集（n={aN}），{b} 为第 {bMedian} 集（n={bN}）。

research.insight.newListings.en: {platform} marks {count} listings as new in this crawl.
research.insight.newListings.zh: {platform} 本次采集有 {count} 部被平台标记为新上架。

research.insight.audienceSplit.en: {share} of tracked {platform} listings are positioned 女频 (n={n}). Platform shelving, not audience data.
research.insight.audienceSplit.zh: {platform} 追踪作品中 {share} 为女频定位（n={n}）。是平台分类，不是观众数据。

research.noResults.en: No listings match. Reset the filters or search a different term.
research.noResults.zh: 没有匹配的剧集。重置筛选或换个词搜索。

research.viewsPooledNote.en: Views columns are platform-specific counters and are never pooled.
research.viewsPooledNote.zh: 观看列为各平台自己的计数，不合并。

research.role.note.en: A publisher label is not the production studio. Neither platform exposes who made a title.
research.role.note.zh: 出版方标签不等于制作方。两家平台都不公开制作方。

research.audience.note.en: Platform audience positioning, not protagonist gender and not measured demographics.
research.audience.note.zh: 平台受众定位，非主角性别，也非观众人口统计。

research.evidence.legend.en: Every number carries its source. Observed: read from the platform's page. Inferred: derived by our rules. Estimated: a model's estimate. Partner-reported: told to us by a producer.
research.evidence.legend.zh: 每个数字都标注来源。实测：从平台页面读取；推断：由我们的规则得出；估算：模型估计；合作方上报：制片方告知。

research.prominence.note.en: Prominence is relative within a platform (0–100). Raw views count different things on different platforms and are never compared across them.
research.prominence.note.zh: 显著度为平台内相对值（0–100）。各平台观看量口径不同，不做跨平台比较。

research.personal.sub.en: Based on the tropes you told us you produce.
research.personal.sub.zh: 根据你填写的主要题材。

research.personal.producingHot.en: You produce it, the charts show it

research.personal.hotNotProducing.en: The charts show it, you don't list it

research.personal.producingCold.en: You produce it, thin on the charts

research.onboard.banner.en: Answer a few questions and this desk personalizes to your tropes.
research.onboard.banner.zh: 回答几个问题，市场页会按你的题材个性化。

research.onboard.sub.en: We use this to filter the market for you. It is never shown to other producers.
research.onboard.sub.zh: 我们用它为你筛选市场数据，不会展示给其他制片方。

research.onboard.audienceHint.en: How you position your titles (女频 / 男频), not who watches them.
research.onboard.audienceHint.zh: 你的剧集定位（女频 / 男频），而非实际观众。

research.onboard.marketsHint.zh: 逗号分隔，如 美国, 英国, 加拿大

research.onboard.readOnly.en: Staff preview: the profile is read-only here.
research.onboard.readOnly.zh: 员工预览：这里不能修改制片方资料。

research.onboard.viewerOnly.en: Only reviewer or approver roles can edit the profile.
research.onboard.viewerOnly.zh: 仅审阅或审批角色可修改资料。

research.title.similarNote.en: Trope overlap (Jaccard). Similarity is not identity: the same drama may appear elsewhere under another title.
research.title.similarNote.zh: 题材重合度（Jaccard）。相似不等于同一部剧：同一部剧可能在其他平台以别名出现。

research.title.notFound.en: This listing is not in the current snapshot.
research.title.notFound.zh: 当前快照中没有这部作品。

research.title.trendsEmpty.en: Trends need at least two observation days; there is {days} so far. Nothing is invented before then.
research.title.trendsEmpty.zh: 趋势需至少两个采集日，目前有 {days} 个。在此之前不虚构任何变化。

research.title.rankMove.absent.en: Not on a chart on either day

research.title.counter.anomaly.en: Counter decreased ({start} → {end}); treated as an anomaly, not negative demand.
research.title.counter.anomaly.zh: 计数下降（{start} → {end}）；视为异常，不代表需求为负。

research.title.counter.noBaseline.en: No baseline: first seen this crawl.
research.title.counter.noBaseline.zh: 无基线：本次采集首次发现

research.title.counter.noCounter.en: No comparable counter on both days.

research.title.creativeEmpty.en: Ad creative observations need a connected source (see Data & Sources). Below are premise sentences from the synopsis, not tested hooks.
research.title.creativeEmpty.zh: 广告素材观测需要接入来源（见数据与来源）。下面是简介的开场设定句，不是经过测试的钩子。

research.title.sourcesNote.en: Source field, unit and read time of every number on this page.
research.title.sourcesNote.zh: 本页每个数字的来源字段、单位与读取时间。

research.title.identityNote.en: This is one platform listing. The same drama may appear elsewhere under another title; similarity is not identity.
research.title.identityNote.zh: 此为平台单条上架记录。同一剧集可能以其他名称出现在其他平台；相似不等于同一剧集。

research.sources.sub.en: What every metric means, where it comes from, how it is defined, and its current state. Credentials and operational logs are not here.
research.sources.sub.zh: 每个指标的含义、来源、口径与当前状态。凭证与运行日志不在此页。

research.sources.detailCoverage.zh: 详情页：{requested} 个中读取 {fetched} 个

research.geo.unknown.en: Unknown (an English page does not establish a US audience)
research.geo.unknown.zh: 未知（英文页面不能说明观众在美国）

research.mine.sub.en: Your titles against the market. Localization and test tools live inside each title.
research.mine.sub.zh: 你的作品与市场的对照；本地化与测试工具在每部作品内。

research.mine.vsMarketSub.en: Each title's tropes scored against the prominent-listing share; open a title for comparable listings and why.
research.mine.vsMarketSub.zh: 按题材与显著作品占比匹配；点开作品查看可比作品与原因。

research.mine.marketScoreNote.zh: 相似度，不代表成功概率

research.mine.untagged.en: No tropes recognized. Add a synopsis to match.
research.mine.untagged.zh: 未识别出题材，补充简介后可匹配。

research.mine.perfEmpty.en: No US performance data yet. Import a distribution or platform report and each title compares to the market on comparable definitions.
research.mine.perfEmpty.zh: 还没有美国表现数据。导入发行或平台报表后，每部作品将按可比口径与市场对照。

research.mine.truncated.zh: 显示前 {shown} 部，共 {total} 部。

research.premise.title.zh: 显著作品的开场设定示例

research.premise.sub.en: The first sentence of each synopsis. Examples of how a premise is stated, not tested hooks: no creative-outcome evidence exists here.
research.premise.sub.zh: 每部简介的第一句。是设定表述的示例，不是经过测试的钩子：这里没有创意效果证据。

research.watch.empty.en: Nothing watched yet. Watch a listing from its page; rank and counter changes appear here once a second observation day exists.
research.watch.empty.zh: 还没有关注的作品。在作品页点关注；有第二个采集日后，这里显示名次与计数变化。

research.watch.readOnly.en: Reviewer or approver roles can watch listings.
research.watch.readOnly.zh: 审阅或审批角色可关注剧集。

research.shortlist.sub.en: An explained hypothesis, not a probability of success. Formula v{version}: comparables (0–50), rights window (±), localization readiness (0–20), your constraints (±10), own evidence (+5).
research.shortlist.sub.zh: 是有解释的假设，不是成功概率。公式 v{version}：可比作品（0–50）、版权窗口（±）、本地化就绪（0–20）、你的约束（±10）、自有证据（+5）。

research.shortlist.reason.comparables.en: Market match {score}: {n} comparable prominent listings, {hot} prominent tropes
research.shortlist.reason.comparables.zh: 市场匹配 {score}：{n} 部可比显著剧集，{hot} 个显著题材

research.shortlist.reason.untagged.en: No tropes recognized in the synopsis

research.shortlist.reason.rightsOk.en: License window covers today (until {end}, as you reported)
research.shortlist.reason.rightsOk.zh: 授权窗口覆盖今天（至 {end}，按你上报）

research.shortlist.reason.subtitlesParti.zh: 英文改编完成 {pct}%（已上传 {eps}/{total} 集）

research.shortlist.reason.scriptsOnly.zh: 已上传 {eps} 集，尚未改编

research.shortlist.reason.targetsUS.en: You listed the US as a target market
research.shortlist.reason.targetsUS.zh: 你把美国列为目标市场

research.shortlist.reason.notTargetingUS.en: US not among your target markets ({markets})
research.shortlist.reason.notTargetingUS.zh: 美国不在你的目标市场中（{markets}）

research.shortlist.reason.noProfile.en: Target markets not set in your studio profile
research.shortlist.reason.noProfile.zh: 工作室资料中未设置目标市场

research.shortlist.reason.ownReports.en: {n} imported report rows link to this title
research.shortlist.reason.ownReports.zh: 有 {n} 条导入报表关联此剧集

research.shortlist.reason.noReports.en: No imported performance for this title
research.shortlist.reason.noReports.zh: 此剧集没有导入的表现数据

research.reports.sub.en: Import your own distribution or platform reports as CSV. Rows are validated before anything is saved; a batch can be reverted. Only your company sees them.
research.reports.sub.zh: 以 CSV 导入你自己的发行或平台报表。保存前逐行校验；导入批次可撤销。仅你的公司可见。

research.reports.columns.en: Expected columns: title, platform, period_start, period_end (optional), metric ({metrics}), value, currency (for revenue/spend). Chinese headers are recognized.
research.reports.columns.zh: 需要的列：title（剧名）、platform（平台）、period_start（开始）、period_end（结束，可选）、metric（指标：{metrics}）、value（数值）、currency（收入/花费需要币种）。中文表头可识别。

research.reports.unmatched.en: {n} titles not in your catalog (imported without a link)
research.reports.unmatched.zh: {n} 个剧集不在剧库中（未关联导入）

research.reports.readOnly.en: Reviewer or approver roles can import reports.
research.reports.readOnly.zh: 审阅或审批角色可以导入报表。

research.mine.perfFrom.en: From your reports (latest period per metric)
research.mine.perfFrom.zh: 来自你的报表（每指标最近期间）
